mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, it is a brisk 43 degrees and overcast near the Verona Public Library. We are in a new moon phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is moving ahead with Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction project. This phase includes finishing concrete curbs and sidewalks, with the asphalt base being prepared for final paving next spring.

There is a busy schedule of events in our community. Today, you can catch Live Music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to Trivia Night at The Mill, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, and even more fun starting at ART House.

In our weekly police report, on October 23, officers stopped two juveniles on Ashton Drive who were riding prohibited electric motorcycles after previously being warned, resulting in citations for their parents.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Chocolate Caramel Twist at Culver's. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so head on over to satisfy your cravings.
